articles.title: Premier League joins call for Fifa reforms
articles.summary: The Premier League joins three of its top European counterparts in calling for "fundamental" reform of the way that world football's governing body Fifa is run.

articles.title: New-look squad, but how will Pocognoli's Scotland line-up?
articles.summary: Former Scotland forwards James McFadden and Pat Nevin try to guess who new head coach Sebastien Pocognoli will pick to start in Slovenia on Saturday.

articles.title: 'Exploitative ideas' - Top leagues criticise Infantino and call for FIFA reform
articles.summary: A joint statement from Europe's top leagues has hit out at "exploitative ideas" pushed by FIFA president Gianni Infantino and called for "essential" reform of football's governing body.
